channel.name: Trent Slade
channel.sampling: Purposive eight-video sample from the initial Latest listing; not a census or a random sample.

observation_window.note: Channel listing was read before the first timestamp. Candidate timestamps mark completion of each candidate observation, not publication time.

steps: Open observed watch links and verify title/channel attribution.
Pause autoplay when a Pause control is exposed; no deliberate sustained playback.
Expand description to read exact displayed date.
Open Settings, then Subtitles/CC where offered, to inspect track labels without selecting tracks or translations.
method.note: Normal watch-page rendering may buffer media automatically; no media-file download/export was requested or performed.

interpretation.positive: A caption track is explicitly listed in the player menu; suitable for future positive extraction testing, not an executed pass.
interpretation.negative_provisional: No captions are offered by the inspected UI; future extraction must confirm or overturn the negative hypothesis.
interpretation.NOT_TESTED: Not independently verified in this inspection. An unavailable value is never silently inferred.

common_evidence_limitations: Single signed-out Cloud Browser observation; YouTube interface language English and locale marker AU.
Only rendered public channel/watch-page UI inspected. No hidden player data, YouTube API, yt-dlp, or subtitle endpoint was queried.
Publication date is the date displayed in expanded description/Video details. Publication instant and timezone are NOT_TESTED.
Duration is the player total displayed at 0:00; no media-file duration validation.
Actual spoken/sung language, caption accuracy, completeness, timing, and downloadable content are NOT_TESTED.
Auto-translate, where offered, is a UI function; it is not counted as an independently supplied caption track. Its target-language list is NOT_TESTED.
A UI-listed track does not establish yt-dlp metadata extraction or subtitle download success. UI absence does not establish permanent or global absence.
No screenshots or full raw DOM snapshots are attached; compact evidence below is transcribed from Cloud Browser accessibility/DOM observations.
